events.title: How a game made in 4 months reached 2 million players - the short story of Dagon
events.summary: Five years ago today, I released Dagon: by H. P. Lovecraft, my first original game. It is a faithful adaptation of Lovecraft’s 1919 story. Some people describe it as a walking simulator without the walking or an audiobook with visuals. You can’t move around - the camera is placed at a fixed position in each scene, and you can only look around within a limited range.But the original idea actually had very little to do with walking simulators. events.title: Price change, origins of horror pool, spinning saws
